Mbappe edges closer to Messi in World Cup Golden Boot race

French footballer Kylian Mbappe scored his 19th career World Cup goal, placing him just one goal behind his rival Lionel Messi in the race for the Golden Boot. This achievement highlights the ongoing competition between the two prominent players in the tournament.
